definitions.explanation: Bitter, painful regret, usually over one's own mistake. Most often used before a noun with の, describing a costly mistake or blow.

examples.japanese: {痛恨|つうこん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ミス→ミス：00285_misu⟧。
{痛恨|つうこん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦エラー→エラー：08429_eraa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{負|ま}けた→負ける：01134_makeru⟧。
examples.english: We lost the game on a painful error.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧な⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧なくした⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{社会人|しゃかいじん}→社会人：13730_shakaijin⟧になって⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{痛恨|つうこん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{出来事|できごと}→出来事：03446_dekigoto⟧だ。
examples.english: Losing those important papers is the thing I have most regretted since I started work.

notes:
A strong, slightly formal word, common in sports reporting and in apologies.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {痛恨|つうこん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ミス→ミス：00285_misu⟧ / ⟦エラー→エラー：08429_eraa⟧: a costly mistake / error
- {痛恨|つうこん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一撃|いちげき}→一撃：08948_ichigeki⟧: a crushing blow (also a phrase from video games)
- {痛恨|つうこん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{極|きわ}み→極み：13140_kiwami⟧: the height of regret (formal apology)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{後悔|こうかい}→後悔：02738_koukai⟧: regret; the everyday word
- {無念|むねん}: bitter disappointment, especially at failing despite effort
